Name: Visible measures must have a format string
Description: Every visible measure needs a format string so values render consistently in every report. Severity 3 blocks the pull request. Measures that use a dynamic format string are also flagged; add a static fallback format string or exclude them.

Name: Visible measures should have a description
Description: Descriptions appear as tooltips in the field list and tell reviewers what a measure is for. Severity 2 is reported as a warning and does not block the pull request.
